title: Maria at the Market
text:
Maria goes to the market every Saturday. She always takes a shopping list with her. Today the list has apples, bread, milk, and two eggs.

At the market, Maria buys the apples first. Then she buys the bread from the baker. She does not buy the eggs because they are too expensive today.

questions.text: What does Maria always take to the market?
Why does Maria not buy the eggs?
options: She already has eggs at home

questions.text: How does Maria probably feel about her shopping list?
options: It is too long to read
It helps her remember what to buy

questions.text: Why does Maria probably go to the market every Saturday?
options: To meet her friends at school
To look for a new house
To buy food for the week

vocabulary.definition: a place where people buy food and other goods
a set of items written down so you remember them
a person who makes and sells bread

paragraph_translations: María va al mercado todos los sábados. Siempre lleva una lista de la compra. Hoy la lista tiene manzanas, pan, leche y dos huevos.
En el mercado, María compra las manzanas primero. Luego compra el pan en la panadería. No compra los huevos porque hoy son demasiado caros.
